newsitem.title: USA: Noxso says injunction granted against Olin.
newsitem.headline: Noxso says injunction granted against Olin.

text.p: Noxso Corp said Tuesday that a preliminary injunction has been granted barring Olin Corp from terminating its supply agreement with Noxso, or taking title to Noxso's facility built under the agreement.
Noxso said the injunction was granted by the Court of Common Pleas of Allegheny County in Pennsylvania.

Under the supply agreement, Noxso built its facility at Olin's plant in Charleston, Tenn., to convert elemental sulfur into liquid sulfur dioxide. Olin is to lease the facility and purchase elemental sulfur needed by the facility from Noxso for 10 years for $3.2 million each year, Noxso said.
Noxso said Olin delivered a notice allegedly terminating the supply agreement and seeking to take title to the facility, as well as declaring a default on a $1.8 million note to Olin.
A spokesman for Olin was not immediately available.
